title: T1091 — Replication Through Removable Media
subtitle: A worm rides a USB drive from the office into an air-gapped engineering room.

steps.title: Infected host
steps.caption: An office laptop already carries the worm (infected days earlier via a dropped drive).
steps.defender: retrohunt the laptop's history - the first infection was probably a missed removable-path execution.

steps.title: Detection
steps.caption: The EDR flags execution from a removable path on the engineering PC; the SOC pulls the file history.
